from_quote: The last clause of the 6th article read
rationale: The journal records the reading of "The last clause of the 6th article".

from_quote: since no religious tests are required
rationale: Abbot speaks of "the exclusion of religious tests" and of the oath to support the Constitution that every federal and state officer takes; both are in the last clause of Article VI.
to_quote: no religious Test shall ever be required

rationale: The journal records the reading of "The 7th article".

from_quote: he cannot pardon in cases of impeachment
rationale: The speaker says the President may grant reprieves and pardons but "cannot pardon in cases of impeachment".

from_quote: treason against the United States shall consist only in levying war against them, or in adhering to their enemies, giving them aid and comfort
rationale: Spaight says "Treason is there defined" and gives the clause's words.
to_quote: Treason against the United States, shall consist only in levying War against them, or in adhering to their Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort

from_quote: and such trial shall be held in the state where the said crimes shall have been committed
rationale: Spaight quotes the clause ("the same clause adds"), after quoting "the trial of all crimes shall be by jury" from "the same article".
to_quote: such Trial shall be held in the State where the said Crimes shall have been committed

from_quote: a district not exceeding ten miles square, although the previous consent and cession of the state within which it may be, is required
rationale: Spaight answers an objection to "exclusive legislation in a district not exceeding ten miles square" with the state's consent and cession.

from_quote: The 1st clause of the 4th section gives the Congress an unlimited power over elections
rationale: The speaker names "the 1st clause of the 4th section" (without its article) as giving Congress power over elections and asks why "the place of choosing senators" alone was reserved.
to_quote: make or alter such Regulations, except as to the Places of chusing Senators

from_quote: the ratification of nine states shall be sufficient for its establishment between the states so ratifying the same
rationale: Lancaster restates the clause on ratification by nine states, calling it "this last article of the Constitution".
to_quote: between the States so ratifying the Same

rationale: The speaker says "Congress is to have power to raise and support armies".

from_quote: Treaties are to be the supreme law of the land
rationale: The speaker says "Treaties are to be the supreme law of the land" and asks that it be amended.
to_quote: shall be the supreme Law of the Land

rationale: Iredell recites the power "to define and punish piracies and felonies committed on the high seas, and offences against the law of nations".
